# DECISION LOG – reva_designs_frontend

No Git history is available, so dates are the context-creation date (2026-10-23) and reasons are not verifiable. Entries describe the *observed* design.

## 2026-10-23 - Custom fetch client named `base44` instead of the Base44 SDK
Context: Project was generated by Base44 (`@base44/sdk`, `@base44/vite-plugin` still in `package.json`; `vite.config.js` uses the plugin).
Decision: `src/api/base44Client.js` re-implements the SDK surface (`entities.X.list/get/filter/create/update/delete`, `auth.*`, `integrations.Core.*`) against the custom Express server.
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence (inferred: keep generated UI code unchanged while swapping backend ⚠ NEEDS HUMAN VERIFICATION).
Affected Areas: all pages; some methods were never reimplemented (`auth.me`, `clearToken`, `loginWithProvider`).
Status: Active
Evidence: `base44Client.js`, `vite.config.js`.

## 2026-10-23 - Local component state over React Query / global store
Decision: Pages fetch in `useEffect` and keep state locally; React Query provider is mounted but barely used.
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence.
Status: Active
Evidence: `pages/*`, `lib/query-client.js`, `PageNotFound.jsx` (only `useQuery` user).

## 2026-10-23 - JWT in `localStorage`, hard redirects after auth
Decision: Token key `reva_designs_token`; login/register/logout navigate with `window.location.href`.
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence. Register comment: "Redirect directly without OTP verification for dev environment".
Status: Active

## 2026-10-23 - Images stored as base64 data URLs
Decision: `UploadFile` reads files with `FileReader` and returns a data URL stored directly in documents (Product.images, Banner.image, QR images).
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence (no storage backend present). Server raised body limit to 20mb.
Status: Active

## 2026-10-23 - Business logic in the client
Decision: Order totals, coupon rules, order numbers, order-item creation and cart clearing are done in `Checkout.jsx`; admin dashboard stats computed client-side from full lists.
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence.
Status: Active

## 2026-10-23 - shadcn/ui (new-york, JS) + Tailwind HSL tokens
Decision: UI primitives from shadcn in `src/components/ui`; theme in CSS variables (burgundy primary, gold accent), Cormorant Garamond + Inter.
Reason: Unknown from repository evidence (Base44 default stack).
Status: Active
Evidence: `components.json`, `tailwind.config.js`, `src/index.css`.
